problems: german-empire is over its page budget (seven pages against five) because the WWI occupations and colony vassals each needed a dated page.
The french-third-republic notes name kingdom-of-syria for me-10, but the mount already has arab-kingdom-of-syria; the orchestrator should use that slug.
Alsace-Lorraine is dated 1919-06 (Treaty of Versailles) in french-third-republic but 1918-11 in the weimar-republic and alsace-lorraine dossiers; reviewer should align the dates.
1915 Poland is a loss in the Russian dossier but an occupation in german-empire; the two treatments differ.
Cliopatria's North German Confederation is Prussia only with members drawn as separate rows; the NGC dossier says so rather than redrawing it.
The Cliopatria Netherlands shape may still contain Luxembourg in 1815-1889; not checked, so a double-cover is possible.
The 1890-97 Solomon Islands cells in the German Empire shapes are unsupported beyond the Northern Solomons.
The validator warns (not errors) that paris-commune, canton-of-cartagena, turkish-national-movement and the German colony slugs have no dossier yet; they are listed in counterparts_needing_dossiers.
